changelog:
1.7.1 - Cards
  ADDED: New MIRROR boss that hunts down fruit and converts what it eats into purple mirror fruit (capped at 6 on the board)
  ADDED: Purple mirror fruit is a gamble - grants +3 score and +2 growth, but flips your controls for 5 seconds once eaten
  CHANGED: Mirror only inverts future inputs; a mirrored turn can never force your snake to reverse into itself
  CHANGED: Boss spawn gap grows quadratically as you defeat bosses (100 -> 400 cap), so each successive boss takes more farming to reach
  ADDED: Cinematic boss-death sequence with hit stop, camera zoom, shockwave, chromatic aberration, debris, and glowing embers (synced in multiplayer)
  ADDED: Off-screen boss and food arrows; the boss arrow is split into head/body halves and the old head glow is removed
  ADDED: Reward-style post-boss upgrade card selection screen for Arcade runs, with auto-fit text
  CHANGED: Score popups show the actual points gained (+1 / +5 / +2)
  FIXED: Audio now plays off the game thread to avoid stutter
  FIXED: Full tail-loop into your own tail is legal unless the snake would grow that tick
  FIXED: Boss-death cinematic uses the classic zoom regardless of camera mode
  FIXED: Crash where the upgrade-card offer list could change on the render thread mid-draw, throwing IndexOutOfBoundsException
1.7.0 - The Big Beautiful August Update
  ADDED: Arcade mode challenges - every run starts with 3 randomly selected objectives from a pool of 20
  ADDED: Completing an objective pays its points instantly with a green flash, a chime, and a floating +X notification; failing one flashes red and plays a fail sound
  ADDED: Completed or failed objectives auto-rotate to a fresh one after a few seconds (no repeats within a run)
  ADDED: Challenge HUD redesigned into a collapsible status-dot strip (top-left) - tap to expand, auto-collapses after ~4s; Direction Lock objectives name the forbidden direction
  ADDED: Boss spawn telegraph - a transparent red vignette, pulsing BOSS INCOMING banner, and a siren before a boss appears
  ADDED: Boss health bar at the top-center tracks remaining segments; bosses glow with a pulsing aura and spawn with a shockwave ring, white flash, and screen shake
  ADDED: Death dissolve - the snake fades out cell-by-cell with a flashing head before the game-over panel; the camera freezes at the death site
  ADDED: Food effects - fruits pulse in with a radial glow and burst into particles (dots + ring) when eaten (green for healing fruit)
  ADDED: Boss combat effects - white damage flash, particle bursts, and a big double-ring explosion plus shake on defeat
  ADDED: Coin-meter score display - a coin in your snake head color, mid-left, popping and floating a +1 on every point; multiplayer shows both coins plus a SUM
  ADDED: Optional on-screen direction pad (D-pad) with a persisted Settings toggle and a hidden illegal-turn button
  ADDED: Full sound redesign - 7 new effects (heal chime, boss warning siren, boss spawn growl, challenge fail buzz, segment-lost snip, game-over descent, pause blip) and reworked existing ones; louder game-over sound
  CHANGED: FIT VERTICAL camera mode now fills the screen height and scrolls horizontally
  CHANGED: Full-screen fade between screens; red/green flashes on challenge results
  CHANGED: Pause icon and challenge strip have larger tap targets; D-pad taps are hit-tested at the press-down point with a wide 90px tolerance
  FIXED: Bottom UI stays above the system navigation bar / gesture pill on edge-to-edge devices
  FIXED: Multiplayer start, restart, and rematch handled on the game thread - no crashes from racing the game loop
  FIXED: Game over waits for the death dissolve; stale boss, death, and particle effects are cleared between runs
1.6.2 — Smash Through the Walls
  ADDED: Wall capture — a player snake that completely surrounds a connected wall group with a closed loop destroys it
  ADDED: Wall groups are 8-directionally connected across toroidal edges; every tile must be fully enclosed before the whole group is removed
  ADDED: Wall destruction triggers the existing wall crumble animation and a new wall-shatter sound effect
  ADDED: Destroyed walls stop blocking movement, boss pathing, and food spawning immediately
  FIXED: All boss types (CHASER, WALL_BUILDER, HEALER) consistently play the default boss damage and boss defeat sounds
